title: heterotheca cinerascens
intro: Heterotheca cinerascens, commonly known as gray false goldeneye, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca cinerascens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Additionally, studies suggest that this plant may exhibit antioxidant and antiproliferative activities, supporting its potential use in the prevention of chronic diseases.
